name: Orc Smasher
tactics: If the orc smasher is within 1 tile of a Hero -> moves adjacent to the closest Hero and attacks with a heavy mace
Otherwise -> the orc smasher moves 1 tile toward the closest Hero

name: Orc Archer
tactics: If the orc archer is adjacent to a Hero -> it attacks the Hero with a punch (+6, 1 damage)
If the orc archer is within 2 tiles of a Hero -> it attacks the closest Hero with an arrow (+6, 2 damage, miss: 1 damage)
Otherwise -> the orc archer moves 1 tile toward the closest Hero

name: Cave Bear
tactics: If the cave bear is on the same tile as a Hero -> it attacks each hero on that tile with a frenzy of claws (+6, 2 damage)
If the cave bear is within 1 tile of a Hero -> it moves adjacent to the closest Hero and attacks with a leaping strike (+8, 2 damage and Dazed)
Otherwise -> the cave bear moves 1 tile toward the closest Hero

name: Duergar Guard
tactics: If the duergar is adjacent to a Hero -> it attacks the Hero with a warhammer

If the duergar is on a tile with no Heroes and an unexplored edge -> draw a dungeon tile from the bottom of the stack and place it next to the duergar's tile. Draw a Monster Card and place its figure on that tile
Otherwise -> the duergar moves 1 tile toward the closest Hero

name: Gibbering Mouther
special: 1 damage and Dazed; attacks all Heroes within 1 tile
tactics: If the gibbering mouther is within 1 tile of a Hero -> it attacks all Heroes within 1 tile (+8, 1 damage and Dazed)
Otherwise -> the gibbering mouther moves 1 tile toward the closest Hero

name: Grell
special: bite: 1 damage and Poisoned (miss: 1 damage); tentacles: 1 damage and Dazed
tactics: If the grell is adjacent to a Hero -> it attacks that Hero with a venomous bite (+7, 1 damage and Poisoned, miss: 1 damage)
If the grell is within 1 tile of a Hero -> it moves adjacent to the closest Hero and attacks with its tentacles (+7, 1 damage and Dazed)
Otherwise -> the grell moves 1 tile toward the closest Hero

name: Human Cultist
tactics: If the cultist is within 1 tile of a Hero -> it moves adjacent to the closest Hero and attacks with a poisoned dagger (+6, 1 damage and Poisoned)
Otherwise -> the cultist moves 1 tile toward the closest Hero

name: Kobold Dragonshield
tactics: If the kobold is adjacent to a Hero -> it attacks with a sword
If the kobold is on a tile with no Heroes and an unexplored edge -> draw a Dungeon Tile from the bottom of the stack and place it next to the Kobold's tile. Place a new Monster on that tile
Otherwise -> the kobold moves 1 tile toward the closest Hero

name: Legion Devil
special: When placing the Legion Devil, place two additional Legion Devils next to the first. You do not gain experience for this card until all Legion Devils are destroyed.
tactics: If the legion devil is within 1 tile of a Hero -> it moves adjacent to the closest Hero and attacks with a sword
Otherwise -> the legion devil moves 1 tile toward the closest Hero

name: Snake
special: Poisoned (no HP damage, applies Poisoned condition)
tactics: If the snake is within 1 tile of a Hero -> it moves adjacent to the closest Hero and attacks with a venomous bite (+7, Poisoned)
Otherwise -> the snake moves 1 tile toward the closest Hero
